newsitem.title: USA: Borg-Warner Automotive files for offering.
newsitem.headline: Borg-Warner Automotive files for offering.

text.p: Borg-Warner Automotive Inc said Monday it has filed a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission for the offering of 4.5 million shares of its common stock.

The shares are owned by Merril Lynch Capital partners Inc, which participated in the 1987 leveraged buyout of Borg-Warner Corp, Borg-Warner Automotive said, adding that the company will receive no proceeds from the sale.
The registration also covers an additional 635,000 shares, which can be used to cover underwriters over-allotments, the company said.
The offer represents Merrill Lynch Capital Partners' remaining stake in the company, automotive systems supplier Borg-Warner said.
Borg-Warner shares closed unchanged at 41-5/8 Monday.
